text: Before any code, what actually happens when someone pays a shop online with a card?
prefix: Before any code, what actually happens when someone pays a shop online with a card?

text: Five players are involved: the buyer, the shop, the acquirer bank, the processing center, and the issuer bank.
prefix: Five players are involved: the buyer, the shop, the acquirer bank, the processing center, and the issuer bank.

text: The acquirer is the shop's bank, the one this series describes, and the issuer is the bank that gave the buyer their card.
prefix: The acquirer is the shop's bank, the one this series describes, and the issuer is the bank that gave the buyer their card.

text: Every shop's website gets an e POS terminal for each card scheme, a virtual POS terminal identified by a merchant ID and a terminal ID, the MID and TID.
prefix: Every shop's website gets an e POS terminal for each card scheme, a virtual POS terminal identified by a merchant ID and a terminal ID, the MID and TID.

text: When the buyer pays, the acquirer sends an authorization through the processing center to the issuer.
prefix: When the buyer pays, the acquirer sends an authorization through the processing center to the issuer.

text: Depending on the card scheme, the issuer either debits the money in a single step, or first places a hold on it.
prefix: Depending on the card scheme, the issuer either debits the money in a single step, or first places a hold on it.

text: A hold is then captured, and only then is the payment final; every scheme, Uzcard and Humo today, Visa or Mastercard later, follows one of these two ways.
prefix: A hold is then captured, and only then is the payment final; every scheme, Uzcard and Humo today, Visa or Mastercard later, follows one of these two ways.

text: A reversal cancels a payment before settlement, and a refund sends money back after it.
prefix: A reversal cancels a payment before settlement, and a refund sends money back after it.

text: At the end of the day, the processing center settles all payments with the acquirer.
prefix: At the end of the day, the processing center settles all payments with the acquirer.

text: The acquirer keeps its commission and pays the shop the rest by the next banking day.
prefix: The acquirer keeps its commission and pays the shop the rest by the next banking day.
